name: Trials of Mary
storyline:
Mary awakens in a high-contrast world with no memory, trapped within a series of isolated and deadly scenarios. Trials of Mary is a story-driven, cinematic survival horror experience where your intelligence is your greatest weapon. Within a modernized nightmare loop, you must confront the darkest rules of classic horror cinema.

This journey, consisting of 4 main chapters each with its own unique atmosphere, offers 5–6 hours of intense gameplay. Stripped of unnecessary details, this experience allows you to directly encounter the most iconic subgenres of horror cinema.
summary: Survive 4 deadly trials inspired by classic horror. As Mary, solve environmental puzzles and outsmart hunters through strategic evasion and self-defense in this cinematic journey. A psychological horror experience where vulnerability and high tension reach their peak awaits you.
